answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can transact, with the stake bonded to one verified identity. Like a pearl that only forms around a single grain, the bond ties one agent to one deposit, so fakes must pay full price for every copy. A public beacon publishes each bond's history, so a meadow of honest agents can spot clusters of identical fresh bonds and refuse them. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs thousands of stakes, while honest agents pay once and keep trading.
